title: Detect when Altium Designer finishes starting
summary: Registers a .NET INotificationHandler (with DispId 266) to receive Altium Designer's broadcast notifications, counts them by type and code, and handles the ApplicationStartupComplete view notification; shows why an extension loaded on first use misses it.
phrasings: run code when Altium Designer has started
register a notification handler in a .NET extension
listen to all notifications AD broadcasts
fix Member not found dialog for notification handler

commands.name: StartupStatus
commands.description: Report whether ApplicationStartupComplete was received and when, whether the handler is registered, and the notifications received by type (view notifications by code)
commands.params: Reset (flag, optional: clears the counts, the startup time and the last error)

commands.name: Listen
commands.description: Register (State=on) or unregister (State=off) the shim's notification handler with IClient.RegisterNotificationHandler / UnregisterNotificationHandler

commands.name: Notification.View
commands.description: Record ApplicationStartupComplete (called by the shim's notification handler with the notification as context; fails when a user calls it)
